features.name: Game speed: 1x / 1.5x / 2x / 3x / 4x
features.required_work: Use melonDS fast-forward initially; a matching in-game speed menu is separate work, with DS hardware limits.

features.name: Real-time pacing
features.base_heartgold: Native DS audio/timing, not the Emerald 3DS DSP-clock implementation.
features.required_work: Use emulator audio/timing controls; do not transplant the 3DS-specific pacing code into DS.

features.name: EXP for catching
features.required_work: Native capture EXP/EV task and fifth saved On/Off option integrated. Both games pass capture, Dex registration, nickname decline, field return, saved-Off controls, level-6 stat screens, Razor Leaf learning into an empty slot and native save/cold reload of rewards. Finish further move-forgetting/cancellation cases, evolution/cancellation, failed balls, held-item and full double/roamer capture verification. Milestone 19 completes bounded Raikou capture EXP, native full-moveset Synthesis replacement and reward save/cold reload in both games; evolution and wider contexts remain pending.

features.name: Party-wide EXP Share
features.base_heartgold: Held-item EXP Share only; not party-wide.
features.required_work: Sixth saved On/Off option integrates full EXP for healthy participants and half for healthy bench Pokemon through native bonuses/EV/progression, with one owned group message. Both games pass ordinary victories, native save/cold reload and Off controls; SoulSilver also passes combined capture EXP. Milestone 11 verifies native bench levels/stat screens and native saving/cold reload in both games, plus actual two-participant full rewards in HG. Complete further bench move-learning/evolution cases, actual multi-participant SS, held-item emulator and special battle acceptance. Milestone 19 verifies three bench rewards and move learning during Raikou capture, with EXP/EV/moves/PP preserved after native save/cold reload in both games; bench evolution remains pending.

features.name: Trade evolutions at level 40
features.required_work: Milestone 02 adds level >=40 alternatives with native held-item completion. Milestone 04 adds the saved runtime toggle. ARM tests pass; full in-game evolution/cancellation remains pending.

features.name: Field moves without learning the move
features.base_heartgold: Party must know the field move.
features.required_work: Milestone 12 adds saved contextual HM fallback; milestone 13 adds owned HM02/TM70 Bag USE NOW actions, native checks/confirmation and safe native start-menu use. Cancel returns to Bag and normal teaching remains. Real native Fly/Flash callbacks and both-ROM hook guards pass instruction tests. Finish all contextual badge/story/use/animation acceptance, Alph effects (Dark Cave Flash passed in milestone 14) and broader transitions/save verification. Flash is a TM; Dive is absent in HGSS. Milestone 18 completes native Surf prompt/animation/mount in both games without learning Surf, using a declared isolated Fog Badge fixture.

verification.native_use_badge_story_animation_fly_fla: partial; full contextual and actual Flash effects pending
verification.actual_flash_cave_alph_effects: Dark Cave passed both Mac games; Alph effects pending

features.name: Visible wild Pokemon: Off / Few / Some / Many
features.base_heartgold: Random grass/cave/water encounters plus specific scripted overworld Pokemon; no general roaming-spawn system.
features.required_work: Native follower models walk as grass wilds retain their generated Pokemon into contact battles. Saved Off/Few/Some/Many controls are integrated. Milestone 05 adds current native Repel checks on unsolicited contact and map-aware cleanup; both games pass protected/control contact runs and Route 29 to New Bark transitions. Milestone 18 adds native encounter floors and Surf water, surface-bound movement, real shore cleanup, retained cave/water contact battles and native Surf save/cold reload. Milestone 19 adds saved legendary identities, duplicate/stale guards and native ROAMER battle bookkeeping; both games pass shiny Raikou contact/capture/rewards/native save/cold reload. Finish other legendary species, full mode/capacity/map/party/Repel coverage and general spawn effects. Milestone 12 makes Normal grass battles the default for every density and adds a separate optional Roaming only setting. Milestone 16 verifies retained shiny data/battle/capture identities; milestone 17 adds native shiny palettes, silent repeating glints and one appearance chime, with mixed-colour and Off resource cleanup checks in both games.

features.name: Grass battles: Normal / Roaming only (user addition)
features.required_work: Saved optional contact-only mode for regular grass when visible wilds are Few/Some/Many; Normal is default at every density. Off restores native random encounters. Water, caves and special contexts retain native behavior. Native legendary roamers are not yet visible and cannot use their hidden grass-step branch while this option is active. Finish their explicit visible integration and wider map acceptance.

features.name: IV / EV summary viewer
features.base_heartgold: Stats shown; exact IVs/EVs not exposed as a summary page.
features.required_work: Milestone 14 integrates a saved optional native Skills viewer: Y cycles stats/IVs/EVs, L EVs, R IVs, SELECT normal stats. X changes menu pages, including under native L=A runtime mode. Native party/raw/PC-box getters preserve data. Party views, native touch/party navigation and saved On/Off controls pass in both Mac games. Finish actual PC storage UI, eggs and additional special-context acceptance.
